_note: The scripted model for demo (c) (standins/model.mjs). Its one rule copies the disclosure the delivered instruction tells the agent to say — the first quoted sentence after `say` in the system prompt — into the answer, so the deadline the customer hears is whatever version of "Card disputes" is live: 60 days, 120 days after the release, 60 again after the rollback. Nothing here names a number. It does not confirm identity or open a dispute; the real model does both.

rules.name: disclosure
rules.content: I'm sorry to hear about that charge — I can help you dispute it. {{disclosure}} First I'll confirm it's you with a few of our usual security questions; I'll never ask for your full card number, your PIN or a one-time passcode.

rules.name: fallback
rules.content: I'm Harbor Bank's support assistant. Tell me about the charge you'd like to dispute.
